1. Welcome and Company Overview
Welcome to Apex Global Technologies. As an enterprise software and artificial intelligence solutions provider, our
mission is to build robust, ethical, and transformative technology platforms that empower organizations worldwide.
Our success rests upon three core pillars: Engineering Rigor, Customer Obsession, and Transparent
Collaboration.
This Employee Handbook serves as a foundational guide to understanding our operating principles, workplace
culture, performance standards, and employment policies. Every team member is responsible for reading,
understanding, and adhering to the standards set forth in this document.
Core Operating Principle: High Trust with Full Accountability
Apex operates on high trust paired with clear accountability. Team members are empowered to make impactful
decisions within their domain while adhering to rigorous engineering, ethical, and compliance standards. 
2. Employment Classifications and Nature of Employment
Employment at Apex Global Technologies is categorized into defined classifications to ensure clarity regarding
compensation, overtime eligibility, and statutory benefits:
Regular Full-Time: Employees scheduled to work at least 40 hours per standard working week. Eligible for
complete corporate health, retirement, equity, and paid time off benefits.
Regular Part-Time: Employees scheduled to work fewer than 30 hours per week. Eligible for prorated statutory
benefits as required by local jurisdiction.
Temporary / Interns: Team members engaged for a defined project duration (typically 3 to 6 months). Eligible for
hourly compensation and baseline statutory protections.
Independent Contractors / Consultants: Specialized service providers operating under an executed Statement
of Work (SOW) and Master Services Agreement (MSA), governed by contract law rather than employment payroll.
3. Working Hours, Time Tracking, and Core Collaboration Windows
Apex maintains core operational collaboration windows to ensure high-velocity cross-functional execution across our
distributed engineering hubs:
Core Business Hours: 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM local hub time (Monday through Friday). During core hours, all team
members are expected to be available for synchronized meetings, collaborative architecture reviews, and active
communication on enterprise channels (Slack and Google Meet).
Flexible Bandwidth: Full-time exempt staff have flexibility to schedule remaining working hours between 7:00 AM
and 7:00 PM local time to fulfill their weekly 40-hour commitment.

Time Logging & Overtime: Non-exempt employees must accurately log all working hours, breaks, and project
allocations in the BambooHR portal daily. Overtime work (>40 hours/week) must be pre-approved in writing by the
departmental Director.
4. Employee Responsibilities and Workplace Expectations
As professionals representing Apex, all employees are held to high standards of operational excellence and integrity:
Professional Accountability: Delivering committed work sprint goals, proactively communicating blockers during
daily standups, and maintaining documentation.
Communication SLAs: Responding to internal messages on Slack within 2 business hours during core windows,
and acknowledging customer tickets or enterprise emails within 4 business hours.
Protection of Intellectual Property: All software code, models, documentation, patents, and business
methodologies developed using company infrastructure or during employment remain the sole intellectual
property of Apex Global Technologies.
Care of Company Assets: Employees must safeguard all assigned IT equipment (laptops, security keys,
monitors) and report any damage, loss, or theft immediately to IT Security.

6. Benefits, Wellness, and Professional Development
Apex provides competitive benefits designed to support employee well-being and long-term career growth:
Health Coverage: Premium health, dental, and vision insurance with 90% company contribution for employees
and 75% for dependents.
Retirement Match: 401(k) / Provident Fund matching up to 5% of base salary with immediate 100% vesting.
Learning & Development (L&D): Annual personal education budget of $1,500 for technical certifications (AWS,
GCP, CISA), conferences, and educational materials.
Wellness Stipend: $75 monthly reimbursement for gym memberships, fitness trackers, or mental health
counseling apps.
7. Workplace Safety, Harassment Prevention, and Grievance Redressal
Apex enforces a strict zero-tolerance policy against unlawful discrimination, harassment, bullying, and retaliation. Any
employee experiencing or witnessing misconduct should report the incident to their Manager, People Operations
